scope: Application control-plane outage simulation; no whole-Pod or managed-database failure is claimed

verified: Per-file size bound and owner-only mode

cases: Exact run submission wait rejects partial, oversized and completed workloads
Only leases valid at one PostgreSQL clock timestamp enter the captured sample
A normal permanent model failure cannot masquerade as lease expiry
Actual lease recovery and old-token heartbeat fencing
Duplicate accepted-attempt ledger corruption is detected
Finally restores after database failure or interruption
Partial restoration attempts all services then retries the original topology
Worker and engine process identities remain untouched in control-flow tests

pending: Explicit release for the fault window
Actual 120-second outage and secondary durable progress proof
Actual watchdog crash/restart proof during inference load
limitations: Dry-run validation performs no fault injection and is not availability evidence
Control-flow tests use a simulated manager; real PostgreSQL observation tests use a disposable isolated database
SIGKILL of the probe or loss of its host cannot run finally restoration
HTTP availability is sampled rather than continuously observed
